title: Carina faces round 2: one specified sweater (9 renders)
question: Is this the same sweater in every picture now, and which of these are Carina's neutral, surprised and tired faces?

media.caption: Sweater compared across all 9: all PASS (ribbed black knit, round crew neckline, plain, long sleeves). Rows: neutral 1-3, surprised 4-6, tired 7-9; seeds 390617760, ...761, ...762 in each row. His approved render (old sweater) sits at the end of row 1. Identity PASS: 4 and 7. DRIFT: the rest (seed ...761 turns her head the other way; some lose the brow piercings). None picked.

Game fit: Carina's surprised and tired (seed ...760, from this round) and neutral (from round 1, because round 2 neutral seed ...760 shows only 1 brow piercing) beside Mio, Aoi, Emi and Eric. tools/portrait_fit.py: scaled only, canvas 648x768, top 70, head 312. Right-hand slot: the round 2 neutral fit, not swapped in. Files: art/approved/carina/.
